contract.scope: Reviewed v1/v2 release contracts; frontend changes flagged for review

coverage.configuration_policy: Use an explicit source effort label when published; create source-specific exact-effort configurations when no matching canonical configuration exists; use unknown only when the source omits effort.

explicit_source_aliases.identity_basis: Captured frontend key/display metadata identifies Muse Wonder 1.0; Meta's official release page names Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full as distinct models, so the key maps to Muse Wonder only.

coverage.identity_policy: Only exact normalized canonical names/aliases from the source display metadata are mapped; unresolved rows remain queued.
coverage.metric_policy: Preserve each published task/suite score on its 0–100 scale. Do not reconstruct suite scores from breakdowns or average across suites/categories. No interval is supplied by these CSV captures.
coverage.release_policy: Keep v1 and v2 as distinct suites; v2 release key 2026-09-02 is reported with frontend display date 2026-10-14.
coverage.scope: Pinned reviewed v1/v2 release keys and frontend asset; new releases require contract review.
